verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a docs entry for starting an application at login. That is a single fixed event (login) triggering a single action, not a user-defined rules engine for automating actions on arbitrary events. Missing for 10: a general event/rule definition mechanism, support for multiple event types (file changes, device connect, time, network), conditional rule logic, AI-native or agent-driven automation, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
